Connect your own data

Call window.ifcTwin.ingestSensor(payload) or dispatch a ifc:sensor CustomEvent in this page. Use the IFC Global ID as spaceId. This is an in-browser prototype, not an HTTP ingestion endpoint.

IFC Twin Studio

Developed by Reachsak Ly.

. Building geometry and IFC identifiers are preserved. Enhanced finishes and lighting are illustrative; this is not a measured lighting simulation or a ray-traced render.

Space readings and capacities are simulated unless you supply a test reading. No building systems are connected. Section cuts are uncapped. IFC property values are shown in their exported units; geometry and cut heights use metres.

This independent prototype is not an Autodesk product.
